propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures in review-plan runs are invisible to callers: failed calls are logged as warnings at swallow sites (~13 across src/rebar/llm/) but produce no counter in the verdict JSON
An empty overlap[] result is byte-identical whether caused by call failures (all-abstain) or genuine non-overlap, making silent degradation indistinguishable from correct behavior

A new contextvars-based run-scoped sink must record failed LLM calls at the single seam (runner.py:573), activate in the plan-review run scope (gate_dispatch), and drain into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty to preserve attestation safety

The failure counter must be keyed by the runner's _call_label verbatim so grep-able log lines match the by_step keys, and must not alter verdict, exit code, signature, provenance, or any existing swallow behavior
The text renderer (_render_plan_review_text in _llm_commands.py:587) must print one line naming total and per-step counts when present, and nothing when absent, keeping plan-review-only scope
A run with no failed LLM calls must omit coverage.llm_step_failures entirely so the verdict remains byte-identical to pre-change output
